_comment: OPTIONAL. Copy to the base root as vocabulary.json to declare the agreed vocabulary.
Without this file `node scripts/kb-vocab.mjs` still finds misspellings and near-variants;
with it, tags outside the agreed set are flagged too.
Keep it SMALL and specific to your company — a big imported vocabulary matches everything
and therefore says nothing. Add a term when it earns its place, not in advance.
